result: Official source semantically separates nomination/acceptance (32/12) from plenary designation (34/12). The same three persons/terms link contextually but claims belong to different record families/stages.
H0: REFUTED for proposition that ESE/000002-01 itself declares legal designation; 2026-09-12 public availability of designation from other sources NOT excluded
alternatives: Plenary session DS(P) dated 10 September may have disclosed outcome to contemporaneous observers; original release timestamp not verified; cannot assert no one knew the designation before 16 September.
limitations: Source indexed extract captured as search text; direct open of exact CCyL URLs got Cache miss in browser, no downloaded immutable source bytes here.
Bulletin date is official issue date, not evidence of first publication exact instant nor of earliest possible release across sources.
A 2026-09-17 date-cut analysis only proxy, not publication-time certified historical backtest.
Selected same three names after discovery; no unobserved controlled sample.
No original Senate XML or current original online media hash in this environment.
